parsedVerdict.reasoning: BaseController's only responsibility is getUserIdFromToken: it parses the Authorization header, verifies the JWT and returns the user id. Reading the caller's identity from the transport layer is a presentation concern. The layer model agrees: it puts guards (src/common/guards/**, **/*.guard.ts), which commonly do this exact JWT check, in the presentation layer. The file has no business rules, persistence or domain logic. Calling jwt.verify directly with SECRET could be argued to belong in an infrastructure auth strategy (**/strategies/**), so this is borderline. However, the method stays within request authentication and identity extraction, which the layer model gives to presentation-kind units. Import direction (config, jsonwebtoken) is out of scope.
